_how_to_use: The blog writer drafts the first topic whose status is 'pending'. Add new topics at the end. 'facts' is the ONLY product information the writer may use, so put in only things you know are true. 'links' are store pages it may link to. Drafts arrive as pull requests for you to review. Topics with status 'paused' are skipped: set them back to 'pending' once their linked product pages are live again.
